notes: §2002:13.3.2 SR1 grants the file section in program, function, factory and instance definitions and forbids it in a method and an interface definition: at --std 2002 each permitted element's FD writes and reads back its own record (P=[PROG] F=[FUNC] C=[FACT] O=[INST], matching the derivation), and the method and interface placements are refused with COBOL1519.
